title: A TRIzol-Beadbeater RNA extraction method for yeast
author: Sangeet Honey
materials: Determine RNA concentration using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Harvest yeast cells
steps.instruction: Harvest 50 mL yeast culture samples by centrifugation at 3,000 rpm for 5 min at 4 °C using a Sorvall Super T21 centrifuge.

steps.title: Resuspend and aliquot in TRIzol
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant by vacuum aspiration, resuspend each pellet in 1 mL TRIzol reagent, aliquot into two 0.5 mL tubes, and store at –80 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Thaw samples on ice
steps.instruction: Thaw one set of frozen yeast in TRIzol on ice.

steps.title: Prepare tubes with beads
steps.instruction: Transfer thawed samples into 2 mL screw‑cap tubes with an O‑ring, add zirconium oxide beads (0.5 mm diameter) from a plastic weigh boat until the bead level is ~1 mm below the liquid meniscus, and pre‑chill tubes on ice to ~0 °C.

steps.title: Homogenize samples with bead ruptor
steps.instruction: Load tubes in a balanced configuration into an Omni International Bead Ruptor 12, homogenize at 3.1 m/s for 30 s, then immediately place tubes on ice.

substeps.instruction: Take a 1 µL aliquot (avoiding beads), mix with 6 µL water on a microscope slide, and inspect under phase‑contrast microscopy; typically >85 % of cells are lysed after one cycle.
If lysis is insufficient, perform a second 30‑s homogenization cycle, avoiding prolonged agitation to prevent overheating.

steps.title: Transfer lysate and add chloroform
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell lysate to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, leaving the zirconium oxide beads behind; add chloroform equal to 20 % of the TRIzol volume (e.g., 200 µL chloroform per 1 mL TRIzol) and gently rock for 3 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge for phase separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 14,000 rpm for 15 min at room temperature in a tabletop centrifuge to effect phase separation.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Identify the clear upper aqueous phase, the white interphase, and the red lower organic phase; carefully transfer the aqueous phase to a 15 mL centrifuge tube without disturbing the interphase.

steps.title: Add binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Binding Buffer (Ambion RiboPure™ Yeast RNA Purification Kit) per 100 µL of aqueous solution.

steps.title: Add ethanol to 70%
steps.instruction: Add 200‑proof ethanol to reach a final ethanol concentration of 70 % and mix according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Purify RNA using kit
steps.instruction: Process the sample using Ambion RiboPure™ Yeast RNA Purification Kit filter cartridges following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute RNA in two aliquots of 25 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0).

steps.title: Measure RNA yield
steps.instruction: Measure and record RNA yield for each extracted sample (e.g., using NanoDrop) and report the yield when publishing results.
